desc: CobraTec Knives is bringing some class to the knife world with our new Titanium flipper with Bohler M390 light stonewashed blade called the ACE. This high-quality CNC machined flipper comes with a frame lock and is suitable for everyday use. The blade can be opened easily with the flipper tab and the blade runs smooth with a ball bearing system. Titanium is noted for its durability, corrosion resistance and lightness as well as being nonmagnetic. M390 is considered one of the best PREMIUM all around blade steels. It offers excellent edge retention, corrosion resistant and durability.
